Shopify vs. Etsy in 2026: The Exact Order Volume Where Shopify Saves You Money

Discover the exact monthly order break-even point where Shopify Basic ($39/mo) becomes cheaper than Etsy’s 6.5% + Offsite Ads fees—and how to run both channels together.

Interactive 2026 calculator with shareable breakdown & CSV export.
Run Your Exact Shopify vs. Etsy Savings Math →

1. The Break-Even Formula: Just ~14 Orders Per Month

Etsy charges $0/month fixed but takes ~9.5% + $0.45 on every organic order (plus 12%–15% on Offsite Ads). Shopify Basic costs $39/month ($29/mo billed annually) with 0% marketplace commission and just 2.9% + $0.30 card processing via Shopify Payments.

That 6.6% per-order fee gap means on a $42 average order value, Shopify saves ~$2.92 per order. At just 14 orders per month (~$588/mo in sales), the fee savings completely pay for your Shopify subscription—and at 65 orders/month with 15% Offsite Ads share, Shopify saves over $2,600 per year!

2. Why You Should NOT Close Your Etsy Shop

The winning 2026 playbook is dual-channel: keep Etsy open as a cold-traffic discovery marketplace (where buyers are already searching with credit cards in hand), and systematically convert buyers into repeat customers on your own Shopify storefront via email lists, SMS, and package inserts.

3. Track Both Channels in One Unified Profit & Tax Sheet
